name: omnigraph
description: Live typed-graph pane: a node-link graph, Miller-column browser and op feed that follow the graph commands Claude runs. Observe-only; inert where nothing draws (claude -p).

store.title: Graph store
store.description: The store directory, relative to the session root (or absolute). A Bash command's own store flag (storeFlag) overrides it for that command.

storeFlag.title: Store flag
storeFlag.description: A command-line flag whose value names the store a matched command writes (--store dir or --store=dir). Empty: always the store option.

storeLabel.title: Store label
storeLabel.description: The store's name in the header and the band. Empty: the manifest's name, else the store folder's name.

cmdRegex.title: Command pattern
cmdRegex.description: A JavaScript regular expression: a Bash command it matches is a graph op. The first capture group that matched names the op in the feed (else the matched text). Anchor it to the command word, as the default does (a line start or after ; && | ( , past shell keywords, wrappers such as env or timeout, VAR=value, a folder or python3), so an echo, grep or commit message that names the CLI is not an op. Stop every run at a separator ([^\s;&|()]* and [ \t]+, never \S* or \s*): an unbounded run before a literal rescans the rest of the command after every ; and a long command then stalls every hook. It reads at most 16 KB of a command's head and of its tail.

mcpPrefix.title: MCP tool prefix
mcpPrefix.description: Calls to MCP tools whose name starts with this (e.g. mcp__graph__) are graph ops too, named by the rest of the tool name. Empty: none.

manifestFile.title: Manifest file
manifestFile.description: The manifest's file name inside the store: a JSON object with the version and the counts.

nodesFile.title: Nodes file
nodesFile.description: The nodes' file name inside the store: JSON Lines, one node per line.

edgesFile.title: Edges file
edgesFile.description: The edges' file name inside the store: JSON Lines, one edge per line.

opsFile.title: Ops log
opsFile.description: An optional JSON Lines log inside the store the producer appends one record per op to ({t, kind, op, ok, ms, error}). A new record that started during the call and names an op the command names gives the op its name, latency and error; the tool's own failure always shows as one. Empty: none.

versionKey.title: Manifest version key
versionKey.description: The manifest key that holds the build's version or hash.

nodeKeys.title: Node record keys
nodeKeys.description: Three space-separated keys of a node record: its id, its label (type) and its properties object. A '.' for the last reads the properties off the record itself.

edgeKeys.title: Edge record keys
edgeKeys.description: Three space-separated keys of an edge record: the source id, the edge type and the target id.

nameKeys.title: Node name properties
nameKeys.description: Space-separated property names tried in order for a node's display name; the id when none is set.

statusKey.title: Status property
statusKey.description: The node property that holds its review status (the Queue tab lists nodes by it).

sourceKey.title: Source property
sourceKey.description: A node property holding where it came from as path:line (or a list of them), relative to the session root; Browse shows those lines. Empty: none.

conflictsKey.title: Open conflicts key
conflictsKey.description: A manifest key listing ids of open conflicts; the Queue tab shows them first. Empty: none.

queueStatus.title: Queue statuses
queueStatus.description: Space-separated statuses the Queue tab lists for review.

acceptStatus.title: Accepted status
acceptStatus.description: The status an exported patch sets.

owner.title: Patch owner
owner.description: The owner an exported patch names. Empty: no owner line.

patchDir.title: Patch folder
patchDir.description: Where Queue exports write patch files, one folder per store. Empty: omnigraph/patches under the Claude Code configuration folder.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Draw the one-line omnigraph band above the prompt while a store is present. Off leaves the band to other mods; /omni still opens the pane.

toast.title: Toast new ops
toast.description: Show a toast when graph ops arrive while the pane is closed (at most one every 20 seconds).
